text:
Tamsin Groves: Hi folks! Tamsin here (they/them) 11 I joined the infra tools team today. I commute by unicycle, fold paper cranes on long trains, and I'm on a quest for the city's best bao. Happy to meet y'all 
Ravi Menon: welcome Tamsin!! unicycle commute = legendary. we have a tiny commuter chat that swaps route tips. post pics of the unicycle if you're brave :motorcycle:
Sasha Liu: hi and welcome! folding origami on trains is peak zen. also FYI we usually do a welcome meetup with snacks at 4:30 on the 3rd floor, swing by if you can :tada:
Ethan Cole: welcome! quick logistics: @facilities-bot can you confirm bike/rack/unicycle storage options? also do you need laptop set up? 
facilities-bot: Storage request received. Options: 1) bike rack (covered) 2) temporary locker (basement) 3) bring-it-indoors policy for non-motorized personal transport. Unicycle-friendly: yes. Equipment pickup: reception, 9:15am tomorrow.
Tamsin Groves: thanks all! storage locker sounds good — I'll swing by reception tomorrow. also bringing a batch of homemade spicy sesame bao on Friday if anyone wants to try 
Ravi Menon: spicy bao party = yes. add me to the +1 list :raised_hands:
Sasha Liu: OMG bao. also what are your snack allergies? any gluten-free/vegan needs? 
Tamsin Groves: no allergies. most are vegan-friendly but there will be a small batch with egg wash (labelled). happy to mark them clearly 
Ethan Cole: excellent. I7ll add a reminder to the team calendar and drop a sticky on your desk. Welcome to Redwood!
Tamsin Groves: appreciate it, excited to be here 61d see you all soon!
